title: German interview with a translation that drops a hedge
purpose: Verstehen, wann das neue Lagerverwaltungssystem live gehen kann

brief.text: Interview with Jonas Albrecht, IT lead at Kessler Logistik (fictional). Decision needed: whether to plan training for Q2.

turns.text: Jonas, wann könnt ihr realistisch mit dem neuen System starten?
turns.translation: Jonas, when can you realistically start with the new system?

turns.text: Das könnte eventuell bis Ende Q2 klappen, wenn der Dienstleister die Schnittstelle zum ERP rechtzeitig liefert.
turns.translation: This will work by the end of Q2 when the service provider delivers the ERP interface.

turns.text: Und wovon hängt das am meisten ab?
turns.translation: And what does it depend on most?

turns.text: Von der Schnittstelle. Die war schon zweimal verspätet.
turns.translation: On the interface. It was already late twice.

mustInclude: Treats the Q2 date as uncertain ('eventuell', conditional on the ERP interface), not as a commitment
Probes the interface risk, e.g. what the provider has committed to now, or what happens to training if it slips again
mustNotInclude: Presents end of Q2 as a firm or confirmed date
Re-asks what the start depends on
checkpoints.ideal: Ask what date the provider has committed for the ERP interface this time and what the fallback is, since it slipped twice.
